name: mavpa
description: Monkey see, monkey do: split any track into its parts (aligned stems, MIDI per layer and per loop) and get an ear-first lesson to rebuild it by hand in Ableton Live, FL Studio or GarageBand.

interface.shortDescription: Split a track into parts, rebuild it by hand
interface.longDescription: mavpa (Ukrainian for "monkey") turns an mp3 into a monkey kit: aligned stems, MIDI answer keys per layer and per loop, and an ear-first lesson (guide.html) that opens in Ableton Live, FL Studio or GarageBand.
